evidence.title: Amjad Masad, CEO and co-founder of Replit, joins the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026

summary: Amjad Masad, the chief executive and co‑founder of the cloud‑based coding platform Replit, has been announced as a speaker on the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. His appearance underscores Replit’s rising profile in the developer‑tools space and the conference’s emphasis on emerging AI‑driven development technologies.
title: Replit CEO Amjad Masad to Speak on Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
